rationale: The stock has gapped down ~18% with no news context available, making it impossible to assess whether this is a fundamental catalyst (earnings miss, clinical trial failure, etc.) or a data error. The bid-ask spread of 138.6 bps is extremely wide relative to the ATR ($0.1157 on 5m bars), meaning the cost of entry alone consumes a significant portion of any realistic intraday move. With only one 1-minute candle of data visible and no clear directional structure established post-gap, the risk/reward is unfavorable in either direction.
